title: LLM Agent A/B Rollout
description: Production control room for immutable LLM agent A/B releases; post-promotion monitoring disabled; shadow Disabled by design.

options.content:
LLM Agent A/B Rollout
A / Control = current model · B / Candidate = model under test

panels.title: Public A2A 20/20
panels.description: Exactly 20 one-shot HTTPS requests must complete through DNS, TLS, NGINX and the public A2A edge.

panels.title: p95 B / A · ≤1.2
panels.description: <1: candidate is faster; 1: equal; >1: candidate is slower. PASS requires ≤1.2.

targets.expr: max by (sample_source) ((max by (sample_source,variant,phase,window_index,verdict) (last_over_time(recsys_workflow_gate_window_p95_seconds{experiment_id=~"$experiment",phase="AB",variant="candidate",latest="true"}[$__range]))) and on (sample_source,variant,phase,window_index,verdict) (topk by (sample_source,variant) (1, last_over_time(timestamp(recsys_workflow_gate_window_p95_seconds{experiment_id=~"$experiment",phase="AB",variant="candidate",latest="true"})[$__range:])))) / max by (sample_source) ((max by (sample_source,variant,phase,window_index,verdict) (last_over_time(recsys_workflow_gate_window_p95_seconds{experiment_id=~"$experiment",phase="AB",variant="control",latest="true"}[$__range]))) and on (sample_source,variant,phase,window_index,verdict) (topk by (sample_source,variant) (1, last_over_time(timestamp(recsys_workflow_gate_window_p95_seconds{experiment_id=~"$experiment",phase="AB",variant="control",latest="true"})[$__range:]))))

panels.title: Rollout controller · one action per Jenkins build
Jenkins actions
panels.description: Each value is a separate short Jenkins build number; Jenkins never selects the next action.

panels.title: Traffic submitted
panels.description: live_test is capped at 360; synthetic_case is exactly 20 with no retry or top-up.

panels.title: Candidate traffic · target vs Envoy vs observed
panels.description: Target is the requested pipeline weight; Envoy is the verified weight; observed is the actual live_test root share.

panels.title: Total passing responses · by variant
panels.description: PASS responses only; the configured total is shown by Evaluation confirmed.

panels.title: Public edge tickets & transport errors
panels.description: ISSUED → DISPATCH_INTENT → CLAIMED → COMPLETED. AMBIGUOUS or REJECTED is never retried or topped up.

panels.title: Latency p95 · root workflow
panels.description: Rolling exploration histogram; the top ratio card uses the closed AB window.

panels.title: Error rate · timeout / runtime-A2A-MCP / contract
panels.description: Runtime, A2A and MCP failures are one combined upstream-error family in durable evidence; the chart does not invent a finer split.

targets.expr: 100 * rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_errors_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s]) / rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_completed_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s])

100 * rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_timeouts_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s]) / rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_completed_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s])

100 * rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_contracts_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s]) / rate((sum by (source,variant) (max by (source,variant,phase) (recsys_workflow_completed_total{experiment_id=~"$experiment",source=~"$source",phase=~"$phase"})))[$__rate_interval:15s])

panels.title: Functional checks · deterministic, no LLM judge
Control · PASS rate on applicable cases
panels.description: Raw deterministic metrics. 100% means every applicable case passed; N/A means this branch received zero applicable cases.

panels.title: Candidate · PASS rate on applicable cases
panels.description: Raw deterministic metrics. Any required FAIL or UNKNOWN blocks promotion; hard failures are never averaged away.
